# The cascade set, pinned: table:column:on_delete:owner
# owner is the referenced table; every line must name a live OnDelete column and
# every OnDelete column must have its line. task_events has none by comment
# (task_event_tables.go), so its absence is asserted here, not left to silence.
agent_session_events:session_id:CASCADE:agent_sessions
project_git_branchs:project_id:CASCADE:projects
tasks:git_branch_id:CASCADE:project_git_branchs
subtasks:task_id:CASCADE:tasks
task_assignees:task_id:CASCADE:tasks
task_contexts:task_id:CASCADE:tasks
task_dependencies:task_id:CASCADE:tasks
task_dependencies:depends_on_task_id:CASCADE:tasks
task_labels:task_id:CASCADE:tasks
task_labels:label_id:CASCADE:labels
user_token_balances:user_id:CASCADE:users
